context: Yumiko reflects with Mei about the loss of her late husband, gentle.
purpose: Widow sharing grief journey with caring daughter-in-law.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: Even now, I feel the loneliness.
lines.style: Soft, careful intake of breath before speaking. Warm but trembling — the kind of honesty that costs something. Slow, deliberate pacing. A slight crack in the middle, then steady again.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Gentle, unhurried. Reaches across the table with her voice before anything else. Warm and certain — not trying to fix, just witnessing. Soft landing on each word.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 思い出、たくさん残してくれた。
lines.en: She left us with so many memories.
lines.style: Reverent, almost whispered. Weight on 「思い出」 — treating the word like something precious being held in both hands. Pause between each phrase. Breathes through the tenderness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Every day becomes gratitude, doesn't it.
lines.style: Soft confirmation, not quite a question. Her voice finds the shape of what Yumiko just said and settles into it. Warm and steady. The smallest smile underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: I'm learning to live alongside the grief.
lines.style: Quiet philosophical turn. Not resigned — more like she's making peace with something true. Steady breath. No performance, just acceptance spoken aloud. A little heavier, a little wiser.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Delivered with genuine admiration, not flattery. Slow enough to mean it. Her voice full of recognition — she's seeing something real in Yumiko. Warm, unguarded.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: I couldn't do this without all of you. I really couldn't.
lines.style: Humble, a little vulnerable on the repetition. The second sentence softer — not insisting, just truthful. Gratitude that's almost exhausted and deeply felt. Eyes probably down, then up to meet Mei's.
